O.outcome_detail: right-hemisphere N170 amplitude difference between Chinese characters and faces

cells.quote: "the N170 amplitude of characters was smaller than that of faces (p = 0.01, Fig. 6B) in the Pre-test. While the N170 amplitude of characters did not significantly differ from that of faces in the Post-test (p = 0.52, Fig. 6D)."
cells.note: The study text supplied above does not include the detailed free-writing planned-comparison results; quote copied from the wiki entry. Children were assigned to groups based on matched measures, but the supplied text does not state that assignment was random.
